question: Radhe Shyam Barle, the notable dancer from Durg, was awarded the Padma Shri Award in 2021 for which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Panthi__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Radhe Shyam Barle** the notable Dancer from Durg was awarded the Padma Shri Award.
 
• Radhe Shyam Barle was the Dancer OF **Panthi **Folk dance form.
 
• **Panthi was a folk dance in the Indian State Chattisgarh.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
